reviewed.id: page-set-input-files.spec.ts > should set from memory
reviewed.evidence: Native setContent installs an input; adapter Page.setInputFiles assigns an in-memory payload. Adapter $eval assertions verify one selected file named test.txt, with no transport failures or native upload calls.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should accept a string
reviewed.evidence: The string predicate remains pending until adapter evaluate changes its observed value, then resolves.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should accept ElementHandle arguments
reviewed.evidence: The predicate remains pending while the retained element has a parent and completes after Page.evaluate removes that same element.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should disable timeout when its set to 0
reviewed.evidence: The watchdog remains active across repeated polling with timeout zero and resolves after the browser condition changes.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should fail with predicate throwing on first call
reviewed.evidence: A predicate error on its first invocation propagates with its original message.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should fail with predicate throwing sometimes
reviewed.evidence: A predicate error from a later polling iteration terminates polling and propagates.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should fail with ReferenceError on wrong page
reviewed.evidence: A browser-context ReferenceError propagates with the missing identifier.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should poll on interval
reviewed.evidence: The unchanged upstream assertion verifies interval polling waits at least the requested duration through browser-side Page.waitForFunction execution.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should poll on raf
reviewed.evidence: The RAF polling form remains pending until an adapter-routed mutation and then resolves.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should respect default timeout
reviewed.evidence: The unchanged assertions verify the configured default timeout produces Playwright TimeoutError identity and the exact timeout message.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should respect timeout
reviewed.evidence: The unchanged assertions verify an explicit timeout produces Playwright TimeoutError identity and the exact timeout message.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should return the success value as a JSHandle
reviewed.evidence: The returned handle preserves the predicate value through jsonValue().

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should return the window as a success value
reviewed.evidence: Page.waitForFunction(() => window) returns a truthy adapter value; the assertion does not verify Window identity.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should throw negative polling interval
reviewed.evidence: A non-positive numeric polling interval rejects with the expected error.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should throw on bad polling value
reviewed.evidence: An invalid string polling option rejects and identifies polling in the error.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should throw on polling:mutation
reviewed.evidence: The method rejects the unsupported mutation polling strategy with the expected error.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should timeout
reviewed.evidence: Elapsed-time assertion verifies Page.waitForTimeout waits for at least half the requested interval.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should wait for predicate with arguments
reviewed.evidence: The predicate resolves only when the serialized argument object reaches the browser callback with both expected values.

reviewed.id: page-wait-for-function.spec.ts > should work with multiline body
reviewed.evidence: A multiline string expression resolves and its handle returns true.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > check retargeting
reviewed.evidence: Across six label and control cases, Locator.isChecked observes false then true after direct mutation; uncheck, check, and setChecked(false) drive the input to false, true, then false.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > direct actions retargeting
reviewed.evidence: Across six DOM arrangements, Locator.innerText returns 'content'; the same div locator passes text, focus, count, JS-property, class, id, and attribute assertions after mutations.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > editable retargeting
reviewed.evidence: Explicit editable assertions and handle editable waits agree across label, readonly control and contenteditable cases.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > element state checks should work as expected for label with zero-sized input
reviewed.evidence: For a visible label wrapping a disabled zero-sized input, Page.isVisible and Page.isHidden report true and false for the label, while enabled and disabled checks report false and true for the input.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > enabled/disabled retargeting
reviewed.evidence: Explicit enabled and disabled assertions agree with label/control and fieldset retargeting; handle state waits complete for the corresponding state.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > input value retargeting
reviewed.evidence: Locator and retained handle report the associated control value before and after fills through labels, and selectText selects the resulting text.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > select options retargeting
reviewed.evidence: The handle reports the selected value changing from dog to cat after selectOption on the label-associated select.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > selection retargeting
reviewed.evidence: The retained handle reports editability and filling/selecting the contenteditable target produces the explicitly asserted value and selection.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > should check the box outside shadow dom label
reviewed.evidence: Page.check('label') checks the checkbox associated with that label inside an open shadow root.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > should not retarget anchor into parent label
reviewed.evidence: Clicking an anchor inside disabled label arrangements invokes the anchor in both cases.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > should wait for enclosing button with a disabled fieldset
reviewed.evidence: The enabled-state wait remains pending while the enclosing fieldset is disabled and completes after enabling the fieldset.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > should wait for enclosing disabled button
reviewed.evidence: A disabled-state wait remains pending while the enclosing button is enabled and completes after its disabled mutation.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > should wait for enclosing enabled button
reviewed.evidence: An enabled-state wait remains pending for the disabled enclosing button and completes after enabling it.

reviewed.id: retarget.spec.ts > visible/hidden retargeting
reviewed.evidence: Explicit visibility assertions and handle state waits distinguish the tested label/control and hidden-parent cases.
